headline: LAA @ CLE matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is LAA 3.87 at CLE 4.26, with a projected total of 8.13. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward LAA: LAA moved -0.11 runs while CLE moved -0.49, changing the projected margin by +0.38 runs. The projected total fell -0.60, which points to a lower-run game script than the earliest saved read. NRFI probability dropped -14.0%, so the first-inning read became more YRFI/early-scoring friendly. Pitching context: detailed start-by-start logs were not available for every starter, so the page separates actual starts from analyzer L3/L5/L10 windows instead of treating those windows as box scores. Batter research is strongest for Chase DeLauter, Nolan Schanuel, Mike Trout, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Rhys Hoskins, Josh Lowe because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
